# REMSFAL – Open Source Real Estate & Facility Management (Community Health & Shared Resources)

**REMSFAL** is an open source platform for the management of residential and commercial real estate.
It connects the three parties involved in day-to-day property operations – **property managers**, **tenants**
and **contractors** – in a single system and replaces scattered emails, phone calls and spreadsheets with
structured, traceable workflows.

This is the special `.github` repository of the [REMSFAL organization](https://github.com/remsfal). GitHub uses
the community health files stored here as defaults for every REMSFAL repository that does not provide its own
version. In addition, it hosts shared GitHub Actions, CI configuration and the design assets of the REMSFAL brand.
A live version of REMSFAL is available at **[remsfal.online](https://remsfal.online)**.


## What's in this Repository

| Path                         | Content                                                                                           |
|------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`         | Code of Conduct of the REMSFAL project (based on the CNCF Code of Conduct)                        |
| `CONTRIBUTING.md`            | Contributing guidelines for all REMSFAL repositories                                              |
| `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`    | Issue forms for bugs, enhancements, epics, features and tasks, plus links to the discussions      |
| `.github/actions/`           | Reusable composite actions: `build-frontend`, `find-merged-pr`, `select-branch`                   |
| `.github/workflows/`         | CI workflow (`ci-build.yml`) checking pull request conditions                                     |
| `.github/dependabot.yml`     | Dependabot configuration for keeping the GitHub Actions up to date                                |
| `design/`                    | Brand assets: logos (`logo_v1`, `logo_v2` incl. white and LinkedIn variants), favicons, GitHub bot avatar and the Cybertron font |


## Adding or Changing Community Health Files

GitHub supports the following default community health files, which can be placed in the root of this
repository or in the `.github/` folder:

- `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`
- `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- `FUNDING.yml`
- `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`
- `PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`
- `SECURITY.md`
- `SUPPORT.md`

For details, see [Creating a default community health file](https://docs.github.com/en/communities/setting-up-your-project-for-healthy-contributions/creating-a-default-community-health-file#supported-file-types)
in the GitHub documentation.


## Contributing

Before contributing to REMSFAL, please read our [contributing guidelines](CONTRIBUTING.md). Participation in the REMSFAL project is governed by the [CNCF Code of Conduct](https://github.com/cncf/foundation/blob/main/code-of-conduct.md).

> **_NOTE:_** When contributing to this repository, please **first** discuss the change you wish to make by creating an issue before making a change. Once you got feedback on your idea, feel free to fork the project and open a pull request.
